label: Low-Distress Graduate Respondent
summary: This persona represents a respondent group characterized by minimal psychological distress, exhibiting notably low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety. The profile is anchored by female respondents with graduate-level education who report spending 1-3 hours on the associated activity.
behavior_markers: Part of a training-split group of size 112

label: High Distress and Loneliness
summary: This persona represents a group of 179 respondents characterized by elevated levels of psychological distress. The profile is defined by significantly higher mean scores on loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms compared to baseline expectations, indicating a cluster of individuals experiencing compounded emotional challenges.
demographic_anchor: Female, Graduate or above, More than 5 hours
